name: Ópera "Amor de Perdição"
description: The Coliseu Porto Ageas presents "Amor de Perdição," an opera based on Camilo Castelo Branco's novel, as part of the second edition of FIATO - Festival Internacional de Artes e Ópera do Porto. The performance explores themes of love, freedom, and destiny through the story of Teresa, Simão, and Mariana.
longDescription:
The Coliseu Porto Ageas hosts "Amor de Perdição," an opera adapted from Camilo Castelo Branco's novel. This production is part of the second FIATO - Festival Internacional de Artes e Ópera do Porto.

The opera features music by Fernando C. Lapa and a libretto by Eduarda Freitas, with stage direction by Ángel Fragua and musical direction by Jan Wierzba. The cast includes Raquel Mendes (soprano), Paulo Lapa (tenor), and Inês Constantino (mezzosoprano), accompanied by Moços do Coro and Oniros Ensemble.

Tickets are available at various price points: Orchestra Chair for €30, 1st Plateia for €25, 2nd Plateia for €20, and Tribuna for €25. A box for 6 people in 1st tier costs €105. The event is recommended for ages 12 and up.
